shots.vo_line: I started hiding from my mum, because I couldn't stand being touched.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat stays hidden under the armchair, blinking warily and shrinking back slightly, while the old woman leans a little closer with a worried smile and slowly extends her open hand. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: And every scratch near my face sent more pain through my whole mouth.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat winces and presses his raised paw against his cheek, his body trembling slightly as the red glow pulses softly; in the background the old woman watches and clasps her hands tighter. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Something changed, and touch became my worst nightmare.
shots.motion_prompt: The hand moves slowly towards the cat's face and the cat leans away, ears flattening further and eyes widening in worry; he stays seated in place. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Even a gentle stroke near my face
shots.motion_prompt: A finger gently strokes the cat's cheek and he grimaces harder, eyes squeezing shut, lips trembling over his sore teeth; his head flinches slightly away but stays in frame. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: sent pain shooting through my whole mouth,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat holds his pained yowl, jaw trembling slightly and eyes squeezed shut while the red glow on his jaw pulses gently; his body stays seated and still. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: because my teeth were covered in years of tartar,
shots.motion_prompt: Tears glisten and slowly roll down the cat's cheeks, his open jaw trembles slightly and his whiskers twitch; the mouth stays open showing the teeth. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: and my gums were bleeding
shots.motion_prompt: The cat presses his paw gently against his mouth, eyes squeezed shut with tears glistening, his jaw trembling slightly and whiskers quivering. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: and infected.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat holds his mouth wide open, tearful eyes looking into the camera, the swollen gums glistening while his jaw trembles slightly and a tear rolls down. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: That's why I stopped coming to her,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat slowly backs a short step away across the rug with ears flat and tail low, while the old woman keeps reaching out with both arms and her face falls. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: stopped eating, stopped playing,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat lies still beside the untouched bowl, wincing and slowly turning his head away from the food and toy mouse, then lowering his chin with a weary sigh. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: and just wanted to sleep alone.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat sleeps curled up alone, breathing slowly with his paw over his mouth, ears twitching slightly; the fire flickers softly in the background. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: It broke my mum's heart to see me like that.
shots.motion_prompt: The old woman knits slowly, her needles moving gently as her eyes well with tears and she glances sadly down at the cat, who looks up at her and blinks slowly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: But she had no idea my teeth were destroying my whole life.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat holds his mouth open, the inflamed gums glistening while his jaw trembles slightly and his eyes blink slowly with discomfort. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Then she started sprinkling Meow Mouth on my dinner. No brushing. No anaesthetic.
shots.motion_prompt: The old woman gently tips the spoon and sprinkles powder over the food in the bowl while the cat watches curiously; the tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: And after just a few weeks,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat eats contentedly from the bowl, his head bobbing gently as he chews, eyes closed with pleasure and tail swaying slowly behind him. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: we both couldn't believe the results.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat's smile widens and his eyes sparkle as he blinks happily, his head tilting slightly and whiskers twitching with delight. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Every meal, it worked through my saliva,
shots.motion_prompt: Inside the open mouth, glistening saliva gently flows and shimmers over the teeth and tongue, while the cat's jaw stays steady and his eyes blink slowly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: breaking down years of tartar and fighting the bacteria eating away at my gums,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat holds his mouth open as his tongue moves slightly, the teeth and pink gums glistening in the warm light, his whiskers twitching gently. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: right down below the gumline, where no treat ever reached.
shots.motion_prompt: The glistening droplet slowly slides down the tooth along the gumline, the small green specks gently dissolving and fading away as light shimmers across the enamel. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: My gums went from bleeding and swollen to healthy and pink,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat holds a big open-mouthed smile, the healthy pink gums glistening, his eyes brightening and whiskers twitching happily as his head bobs slightly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: and eating finally felt good again. So I got my happy life back.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat happily scoops a biscuit with his paw, licking his lips and purring, his tail curling slowly above him while he stays beside the bowl. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: I started eating properly, playing, running around,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat wiggles playfully in his crouch, eyes following the feather toy as it sways gently above him, his tail swishing side to side; he stays on the rug. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: and coming back for cuddles.
shots.motion_prompt: The old woman gently hugs the cat and rocks slightly, smiling with her eyes closed, while the cat nuzzles into her cheek and purrs contentedly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: This tasty powder helped me feel like my younger self again,
shots.motion_prompt: The cat licks his lips with satisfaction and blinks happily, his ears and whiskers moving slightly; the tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: and I'm finally enjoying my senior years the way I always should have.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat reads contentedly, slowly turning a page with his paw and gently swishing his tail, while flowers and leaves sway softly in the breeze. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: But hurry! Meow Mouth is giving away a free tub with every two you order, while stocks last.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat smiles brightly and nods his head slightly with excitement, ears perked and whiskers twitching, staying seated behind the tubs; the tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: So tap the link below and claim your free tub before they're gone.
shots.motion_prompt: The cat gently pats the lid with his paw and smiles at the camera, blinking happily while staying seated; the tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
